description: Podatki državnih omrežij GNSS is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GEODETSKI INŠTITUT SLOVENIJE. Two national GNSS networks are in place: - SIGNAL network (acronym: SlovenIja-Geodesia-Navlgacija-Location) and - a combined zero-order geodetic grid. The SIGNAL network is intended to provide positioning data and services by reference to the national reference coordinate system. Coverage: GEODETSKI INŠTITUT SLOVENIJE. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS national network data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is GEODETSKI INŠTITUT SLOVENIJE. Its keywords include Nacionalno. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
